notes.title: Upcoming PISTOLA update
notes.content:
[h1]Upcoming PISTOLA 1.3.0[/h1]

I always talk about PISTOLA as a game we're ashamed of. We thrive to make games we'd like to play regardless of playtime and the niche it fills, so why weren't we treating this one as such?

After a really honest, well made and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/renatocf/recommended/1956400/]insightful review[/url], I cloned the PISTOLA repo and started doing some changes.

The performance issue specifically, are a well-known one and multiple people have reported. I had no idea what was done there but I didn't expected it was [b]that[/b] bad (my fault, though!)

So, the first step was reworking the enemy code. If an image worths a thousand words, a video worths even more. Here's a before/after with the same amount of enemies spawned (note that as of now, the game gets slower even with games outside the viewport)

[previewyoutube=NK6KenPbVqI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Note that this is [b]not released[/b] yet![/h3]

The goal is to make a update with new content, and I also need to further investigate if player powerups are another source of performance problems so I can handle it as well.

I already have a nice backlog of possible features for this update, such as:
[list]
[*] Weekly leaderboard
[*] New characters with exclusive mechanics
[*] New powerups
[*] New languages
[*] A... companion?!
[/list]

And that's the part where YOU come in!

[h2]Discord Community[/h2]
You can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/CbXrxCmUv3]Discord Server[/url] (or just comment here) suggestions you'd like to see on a new version of the game. We're open to feedback.

[h2]Siege 'n Sow[/h2]
I'd like to also point out that Siege 'n Sow, our newest game in development, has a steam page so you can add it to your wishlist if you want, it helps us a lot! But notice that since this is our main priority, PISTOLA 1.3.0 may not be released quick. But it will come!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2773700/Siege_n_Sow/

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1: QoL improvements and "infinite" content
notes.content:
We just released a new quality of life update, fixing bugs, and improving the late game. One of the major changes is definitely the new enemy creation algorithm, that previously stopped on the latest enemy we drew (which is quite boring, to be honest), now the game will loop through the list of enemies infinitely, making'em stronger each time the algorithm loops.
[list]
[*] New enemy creation algorithm
[*] New random buffed enemies (1% of chance to spawn)
[*] Merchant countdown timer on the top-right of the screen
[*] Increased base coin drop chance (45% to 50%)
[/list]
Thanks for playing, enjoy the new updates!

notes.title: 🎉 PATCH 1.2.0 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]About[/h2]
Thanks for the patience! We're extremely happy to release a new update for [b]PISTOLA[/b].

First of all, the developer (cauehsf) deeply appreciates the love of all players, but we have to exalt three names that are on the top of the scoreboard:
[list]
[*] 🥇 TURBOTOTA
[*] 🥈 KLUSTERFAK
[*] 🥉 DGID
[/list]
We added a podium to the menu to encourage players to search for better rankings!

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Bleeding (damage, duration and hit count)
[*] Merchant cooldown reduction
[*] Better rewards after killing enemies
[*] Chance of dropping a permanent coin after killing enemies
[*] ⚡ LIGHTNING DAMAGE! ⚡ (Thanks, Pilalo!)
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
We've noticed that on the late-game of each run, there is a performance issue due to the enormous enemy quantity on the screen. We're working on that, eitherway, hopefully we solved almost everything related to that on the current patch.

[h2]Future of PISTOLA[/h2]
We're grateful for everything we've achieved so far, and certainly [b]Softwool[/b] will release a new title soon (👀). PISTOLA is pretty near to it's final stage, and we must warn you that the next updates will mainly be focused on bug fixes, and quality of life improvements.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.9: Roll the drums for the 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Bugs found on previous versions (1.1.6 ~ 1.1.8) were fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player's hurtbox was fixed (couldn't be hurt from the bottom of it)
[*] Enemies spawn further away from player
[*] CAVEIRUDO's move speed limited to a common sense value
[/list]
[h2]Not-planned improvements for 1.1.9[/h2]
[h3]Some improvements for 1.2.0 were applied in 1.1.9[/h3]
[list]
[*] Critical hit damage upgrade
[*] Critical hit chance upgrade
[*] Bullet's speed upgrade
[/list]
[h2]Roll the drums for the version 1.2.0[/h2]
[h3]New enemies, upgrades and achievements![/h3]

As we said on the previous patch note, we're planning to release [b]1.2.0[/b] as soon as possible. Meanwhile, some improvements were applied on the current version (1.1.9), remaining the following updates:
[list]
[*] Upgrades related to bleeding, poisoning, and [b]LIGHTINING[/b]!
[*] New monster species
[*] New monster achievements
[*] Permanent upgrades buy process will be easier
[/list]

notes.title: PISTOLA updated to version 1.1.6
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Enemy collisions problems were fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies do not pass through each other
[*] Enemies do not push each other
[*] Unexpected enemy flying around really fast fixed
[*] Enemy's death sound variant is now playable
[/list]
[h2]Preparation for 1.2.0[/h2]
[h3]Thanks for the patience and we're sorry if you faced any bug during your gameplay.[/h3]

We have some good news, one of them is definetely about the next big update (1.2.0), bringing to the game a lot of improvements:
[list]
[*] Critical damage related upgrades
[*] Bleeding and poison upgrades will be added to the merchant
[*] New monsters coming around to kill you
[*] New monster related achievements
[*] Permanent upgrades buy process will be easier
[/list]
